fragments.contract: Install Server2 using Proxmox's supported auto-installer flow: checksum-gated ISO assets, embedded answer file, exact-MAC one-shot PXE, observe HTTP initrd handoff, disarm PXE, then validate disk boot, SSH, root@pam API login, KVM, local storage, and local-lvm.
fragments.why_it_matters: The successful Proxmox path came from letting the commercial installer own the install semantics while BKC controls boot, evidence, handoff, and validation.
fragments.do_not_repeat: Do not dissect the Proxmox installer into unrelated Debian preseed logic. Do not leave the exact-MAC PXE fragment armed after handoff.

fragments.contract: After installer handoff, DHCP/PXE must be disarmed and the host must boot from PERC/local disk rather than entering another PXE installer loop.
fragments.why_it_matters: During rehearsal, Server2 appeared to reinstall or hang at PXE when boot order and PXE state were not cleanly separated.
fragments.do_not_repeat: Do not debug Proxmox disk contents before checking whether the machine simply booted PXE again.
